[[page 1]]
LT-300 Owner's Manual - Wheels and Tires

Recommended cold tire pressure: front 3.1 bar, rear 3.4 bar.
Rotate the tires every 10,000 km. Check the tire tread depth monthly.

[[page 2]]
Brakes: if the brake warning light stays on, contact a dealer. Do not drive with a loose wheel or caliper.
